name: Prime Brothers
background:
The Prime Brothers represent the pinnacle of gene science, a small number of super human individuals with advanced armour and weaponry, which rely on their skill and durability to achieve victory against any odds.

Prime Brothers are enhanced with the latest gene-mods, adapted from discoveries made after arriving in Sirius. The process that creates Prime Brothers gradually destroys the body, leaving them with significantly shortened lifespans. Despite this, many young soldiers still choose to become Prime Brothers, proudly dedicating their short lives to the Conduit and his cause.
backgroundFull:
Battle Brothers were created by a visionary scientist, known as the Founder, who used a series of gene-mods in order to enhance soldiers beyond their human limits. The Battle Brothers were quickly deployed to maintain unity and peace over Earth and its nearby colonies. The gene-mods proved wildly successful and many sought to join their ranks. 

When humanity arrived in Sirius, they encountered new challenges, as previously unknown phenomena, technology and threats were commonplace in Sirius. In order to adapt, the gene-mods of the Battle Brothers were experimented upon in order to further increase their capacities. The results of these experiments were soon rolled out and distributed to each Detachment, to allow them to train and equip these recruits to become Prime Brothers.

Once their training was completed, the Prime Brothers were formed into new Detachments and deployed to the Frontier. Rather than reinforcing the existing Battle Brothers forces, they were assigned to explore and fight far from the core of the galaxy. 

Many Prime Brothers began to show damage to their muscles, joints and bones, as their bodies were unable to adapt to the gene-mods. These flaws were found in every Prime Brother, but for some the deterioration was much slower than others, with it taking decades for the worst effects to show in some, but until then, each Prime Brother remained a highly effective warrior.

The Prime Brothers carried on even after these side effects were discovered, however, despite the wishes of the Custodians, they revealed the side effects of their gene-mods publicly. Despite this, many recruits were still willing to accept the risks in order to join their ranks. Prime Brothers know their enhancements mean that they are more likely to die from deterioration than in battle, as a result many are willing to take risks others would deem unacceptable. This has only further built their reputation as heroes and drawn in more recruits who idolize them.

Due to their shortened life spans, Prime Brothers often lack the organization and personal experience of the Battle Brothers, so they rely on their advanced technology and individual heroism to overcome this disadvantage. While some Battle Brothers may view them as reckless, others have developed a keen respect for the bravery and sense of sacrifice common to the Prime Brothers.

How will your short lifetime serve the Founder’s vision?

specialRules.name: Primeborn
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Vanguard
specialRules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

specialRules.name: Melee Shrouding Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Melee Shrouding.

specialRules.name: Precise
specialRules.description: Gets +1 to hit when attacking.

specialRules.name: Armor
specialRules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

specialRules.name: Mend
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

specialRules.name: Bravery Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get +1 to Morale Test rolls.

specialRules.name: Evasive
specialRules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls when attacking units where most models have this rule.

specialRules.name: Retaliate
specialRules.description: When this model takes wounds in melee, the attacker takes X hits per wound taken.

specialRules.name: Ravage
specialRules.description: Once per round, when it’s this model’s turn to strike in melee, roll X dice before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

specialRules.name: Bane when Shooting Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Bane on its weapons when shooting.

specialRules.name: Regeneration Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Bane in Melee Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Bane on its weapons in melee.

specialRules.name: Rapid Rush Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Rapid Rush.

specialRules.name: Versatile Reach Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Versatile Reach.

specialRules.name: Re-Deployment
specialRules.description: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next.

specialRules.name: Versatile Expert
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) when attacking, or get +1 to hit rolls when attacking.

specialRules.name: Anti-Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Unstoppable Mark
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unstoppable on their weapons against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Cumbersome
specialRules.description: May only use Hold or Advance actions, but can’t shoot when moving.

specialRules.name: Melee Slayer
specialRules.description: When charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher.

specialRules.name: Pierce
specialRules.description: Ignores all positive Defense modifiers on the target, and when attacking units over half of this weapon's range away, this weapon gets AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Unstoppable
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: AP

specialRules.name: Melee Shrouding
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for charging, that enemy unit gets -2" range to a min. of 6".

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: This model must take X wounds before being killed. If a model with Tough joins a unit without it, then it is removed last when the unit takes wounds. You must continue to put wounds on the Tough model with most wounds in the unit until it is killed, before starting to put them on the next Tough model (Heroes must be assigned wounds last, even if already wounded).

specialRules.name: Bane
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Rapid Rush
specialRules.description: This model moves +6" when using Rush actions.

specialRules.name: Versatile Reach
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, all models with this rule in this unit either get +4" range when shooting or move +2" when charging.

specialRules.name: Shred
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.
